question: What attainment is identified as belonging to the root Kaula, O fair-faced one?
premises: These accomplishments are linked to attainment.
This attainment is identified as the root Kaula.
inference: The attainment of the eight siddhis constitutes the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact internal compound structure of siddhisaṃprāptirmūlakaulaṃ is compressed by sandhi and fusion.
plain_english: And the attainment of the eight siddhis is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
